says: Level.sev0Fixes, which tells a sev0 fix from a ready pull request, and land.ts's adminRoute that builds the route from the log have no test; Merge.test.ts builds the route by hand.
proof: grep -rn 'sev0Fixes\|sev1Fix' over the tracked .ts files finds the calls only in land.ts, Incident.ts and Level.ts; the only test mention of sev0Fixes is a comment at Merge.test.ts:8-9, which routeFor (Merge.test.ts:240) replaces with a hand-made route.
cost: A change that reads an `allow` line as a fix (an ancestor check on every ready pull request) or a ready one as a fix (none on a fix) passes every law.
